name: solute carrier family 16 member 13

function.text: SLC16A13 is the approved symbol for solute carrier family 16 member 13. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in monocarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: SLC16A13 encodes solute carrier family 16 member 13. Its functions include monocarboxylic acid transmembrane transporter activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving SLC16A13 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, gastric adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
